q: Which file do I give to the server: id_ed25519 or id_ed25519.pub?
expl: The file without an extension is the private key. It never leaves your computer.

q: Key login worked yesterday. After someone ran chmod 777 on the home folder, it says Permission denied. Why?
opts: sshd ignores keys that other users could change
expl: Home, dot s s h and authorized_keys must not be writable by others. Fix the permissions and the key works again.
